import anndata as ad
import numpy as np
adata=ad.read_h5ad('pbmc3k.h5ad')
mask=adata.obs['louvain'].to_numpy() == 'B cells'
gene_idx=adata.var_names.get_loc('S100B')
vals=adata.X[mask, gene_idx]
print('n', vals.size, 'gene_idx', gene_idx, 'type', type(vals), 'dtype', vals.dtype)
print('sum', repr(np.sum(vals)), 'mean', repr(np.mean(vals)), 'min', repr(np.min(vals)), 'max', repr(np.max(vals)), 'nonzero', int(np.count_nonzero(vals)))
print('unique', np.unique(vals, return_counts=True))
print('formatted', f'{np.mean(vals):.2f}')
PY"
